text:
maria_p: Kicking off thread — we need a concise playbook for onboarding models that customers pin or demand backward-compat. Big customer ask from FinCorp. Requirements below.

samir: +1. Can you list acceptance criteria? latency/accuracy targets?

jess: Quick note — keep the playbook runnable via CLI and Console.

maria_p: Proposed acceptance criteria: benchmark parity <=5% latency vs current pinned baseline, quality regression <=0.5% on customer prompt set, token-cost delta tracked, migration window >=90 days, opt-in canary per-tenant, automated rollback.

alex_r: From runtime side: we can do a compatibility shim for certain quant profiles but behavior can differ for extreme quantization. Need a model-variant compatibility matrix and tests.

elaine: Support & CSM ask: must have comms template (customer-facing), runbook steps for staged cutover, and a customer dry-run 3 weeks before final.

samir: Technical checklist draft (starter):
```
- run perf benchmark (redwood-bench) on pinned model
- run quality delta evals vs nominated target model
- create canary config: {percentage: 5, duration: 48h}
- enable KV prefix cache migration and verify warmup latency
- create rollback tag & metric alarms (error-rate, hallucination-rate, token-cost)
```

jess: For evals: must include customer's sampled prompts + Redwood canonical suite. Keep sampling reproducible. Link to canonical suite: https://go/repo/onboard-evals

maria_p: Also need policy for PIN exceptions: TTL, extension requests, and criteria for forced migration. UI + API surfaces required.

alex_r: Eng note: quantization + tokenizer changes are the two highest risk vectors. We should add an adapter shim prototype that runs a small diff on tokenization and outputs delta report.

elaine: Comms checklist: internal ops playbook, customer email template (T-30, T-14, T-3), rollback instructions, contact matrix. Also legal review if customer collateral mentions benchmarks.

samir: Who owns telemetry? We want per-tenant token-level cost + simple hallucination proxy (n-gram repetition / low-confidence tokens) for 30d post-migration.

alex_r: Eng-infra will own hooking telemetry into Console alerts. Backlog items: model-compat test runner, migration smoke tests, canary rollout automation. ETA estimate: 3 sprints for basic coverage.

ops-bot: canary created for FinCorp — id: canary-20260301-42

elaine: Proposed launch gates: all automated checks green, customer signoff on evals, rollback playbook validated, 7-day SLO monitoring post-rollout.

samir: Risk register note: quant/precision mismatch can subtly change semantics — treat as HIGH risk and require customer review if >0.2% quality delta.

maria_p: Action items: @alex_r build compat harness, @jess write eval suite template + reproducible sampling instructions, @elaine craft comms + runbook, @samir define rollback thresholds & alarms. Schedule sync Wed 10am.

jess: I'll drop the eval template into the shared doc: https://go/docs/model-migrate-template

marco_s: +1 to timeline. Loop in legal on comms if metrics referenced publicly.

maria_p: Thanks everyone — I'll convert this into a short runbook and attach it to the catalog entry once it's stable. :tada:
